sources.use: The behaviour specification this package implements. Nothing upstream was opened, decompiled or read to write this package.

The rights record the specification was written under, which clears code and behaviour and leaves names unresolved. Two consequences are visible in this package: no identifier here is carried across, so aliases.json is empty; and the three serialised redstone spellings and the wide check's polynomial are compatibility-required values that record leaves unobtainable, so both are read from a build-time input and both have a placeholder the tests pin the surrounding format with.

The whole of what this package names of Ravel's own surface: content declaration and the registration barrier, configuration declaration and resolution, the packet contract and its framing, saved-data declaration and envelopes, and the side model.
